data.gender_notes: Ekrama is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful garland of fragrant flowers, adorned with grace and elegance. Parents who choose Ekrama usually hope their child will grow to embody garland of flowers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
